_envelope._assertion: OAuth refresh path triggers — `vendor_credentials.token_expires_at` is inside the 24h horizon (`kRefreshExpiryHorizon`), so pg_cron job `proxy.refresh_expiring_inbound_vendor_tokens` selects this row. RevelOAuthRefresher.refresh re-exchanges client_credentials; new access token persists with new expires_at; consecutive_refresh_failures resets to 0. Per docs/integrations/revel/oauth_shape.md, Revel's client_credentials flow does NOT issue a refresh token, so refresh is a fresh exchange of the stored client_id/client_secret pair (no rolling refresh-token rotation).

stored_credential_state_before_refresh.refresh_token_ciphertext_b64: n/a — Revel client_credentials does not issue a refresh token
stored_credential_state_before_refresh.horizon_check: token_expires_at < now() + interval '24 hours' => TRUE => row selected
